name: Glutamine
summary: A popular 'recovery/anti-catabolic' amino acid with no evidence for building muscle in healthy lifters who eat enough protein. Skip it.
effect: A controlled resistance-training trial found glutamine supplementation had no significant effect on muscle performance, body composition, or muscle protein breakdown versus placebo. Any role is in clinical illness/gut health, not hypertrophy.
dosing: Not recommended as a muscle-building aid. (Doses of ~0.9 g/kg have been studied without hypertrophy benefit.)
safety: Generally safe; the issue is lack of benefit, not risk.
